story.short_description: Aurelius, The Celestial Arbiter. The divine judge of the fractured timeline.
story.long_description: Aurelius resides in the Astral Sanctum, acting as the ultimate judge of all cosmic events. Forged from pure starlight and unwavering law, he brings divine order to a chaotic universe, wielding the Astrolabe of Judgement to mete out celestial punishment.
story.origin: Manifested from the First Light of the Fracture
story.purpose: To maintain the absolute cosmic balance between order and chaos.
story.legacy: A divine presence whose judgment is final and absolute.

combat.combat_style: Majestic and distant, using celestial geometry and blinding light to execute enemies from afar.

visual_identity.material: White Ceramic, Royal Gold, Deep Blue Velvet

personality.fear: The corruption of the cosmic scales
personality.strength: Unmatched celestial magic and absolute authority
personality.weakness: Lacks empathy; judges purely by cosmic law without exception.

art_direction.silhouette: Regal, imposing knight with a towering crown and a massive celestial staff.
art_direction.pose: Commanding, majestic, levitating a glowing prism in one hand while holding the staff in the other.
art_direction.camera: Epic, low angle, showing the sheer scale of the golden realm.
art_direction.environment: A bright, heavenly ancient architectural realm filled with gold structures, floating blue crystals, and a massive golden celestial ring/astrolabe in the background sky.
art_direction.lighting: Brilliant, divine golden sunlight and glowing azure energy.
art_direction.materials: Pristine white ceramic, polished royal gold, dark blue fabric, glowing azure gems.
art_direction.art_direction_notes: The intricate gold filigree over the white ceramic is the defining texture of his armor.

lore.origin: When the Fracture occurred, the purest light from the tearing of the cosmos coalesced into Aurelius.
lore.history: He constructed the Astral Sanctum from the debris of dead universes, creating a flawless golden realm where he observes the timeline.
lore.purpose: To judge the worthiness of all factions and maintain the absolute cosmic balance.
lore.legend: When the sky turns gold, the Arbiter has rendered his verdict.
lore.current_mission: Monitoring the corruption of the Void.
lore.secrets: He knows how the universe will end, and he is sworn to let it happen.
quotes: "Order is the only truth. All else is a lie waiting to be corrected."
famous_battles: The Banishment of the Dark Tide
lore.architect_notes: We created the universe, but he rules it.

rivals: Malakor (Views his chaotic methods as a threat)
